_approved: Owner approved these gates as proposed (AskUserQuestion, 2026-11-14).
_status: PROPOSED 2026-11-14 for the proxy markets (b3/markets.py). Same logic as lab/config/gates.json, with returns as a share of the notional of 1 unit per trade (1x, no leverage). Written before any backtest of these markets. Once approved, edits need the owner.
_minimum_trades: Below this in a split the decision is 'inconclusive'. Trades per year are reported; day trading aims at 200+ per year.
_net: Compounded net return over the split must beat floor x (1 + 0.1 x prior variants) in BOTH the base and the conservative cost scenarios. Prior variants = distinct (rule, market) pairs already read on exploration (research/proxies/ledger.jsonl).
_positive_years: Share of calendar years in the split with a positive net return (base cost) must be at least this.
split_progression: A rule must pass on exploration and then, read ONCE, on validation of the same market before it becomes a candidate for the demo forward test. The final test is never read while splits_proxies.json final_test_unlocked is false.
